observed: Dense maize/cereal canopy on parallel metal transport lanes; tapered grey pots supported by round black carriers with red guides.
Closely spaced reflector lamp array, insulated chamber panels and reflective upper wall finish.
Hallway overhead conduits, nutrient tanks in a yellow bund, drain channel, wash station and dark process panels.
Hyperspectral booth dark background, vertical camera carriage, articulated lamp brackets and cables.
inferred: Crop morphology and all leaf dimensions are original representative maize geometry, not reconstructed individual plants.
28 potted crops, four static lanes and 56 reflector lamps are chosen to represent observed density within the estimated room envelope.
Reflector type, intensity and spectral output are uncalibrated; pipe routes and fixture placements are estimated.
The imaging booth retains its existing functional surrogate axes and dimensions; added specimen and light geometry is illustrative.
implemented: Reusable closed tapered leaf ribbon meshes with a center fold and curved drooping tips; hollow tapered pot body and ID tabs.
Paired profile conveyors with belts, extrusion slots, idlers, motors, levelers and red stop handles.
Separate internal growth-room ceiling, reflector lamp array and hall service geometry.
Refined maize specimen attached to the mechanically operated imaging turntable, retaining conveyor, rotation and camera-height controls.

Imaging specimen uses a smaller young-maize morphology. Conveyor stroke reduced from 1.08 m to 0.80 m because the former full-travel endpoint pushed even the pot through the rear backdrop. A geometric audit samples 51 transformed poses and conservatively bounds the whole yaw sweep.
Reflector lamps use hollow eight-sided tapered cups with recessed bulbs instead of stacked flat panels. Reflector dimensions and brightness remain estimates.
unresolved: No measured facility floor plan or calibrated reference camera registration.
Original mixed crop species, actual lamp count, manufacturer-specific conveyor CAD and exact booth geometry are not reconstructed.
No simulated growth, nutrient hydraulics, photometric calibration or hyperspectral measurement.
